en: Two-sided WWI-era postal card. One side is a long handwritten message in Serbian Cyrillic dated 8 March 1918 with the place name written as "Шели" (Šeli). The other side is a French-format back reading "CARTE POSTALE," with French postal instructions, several postal cancellations and a purple censor/office mark. It is addressed in French to a recipient in "Salonique" (Thessaloniki) with military post number "S.P. 216." The sender's address line mentions "à Chebli, Alger." No photograph or landmark is depicted.
